continuation: all-advance-v1; q=log(native latency / same-program root default latency); maximize -q; S2 observe-only retains S1 branch score

training.selection: minimum validation candidate-set log regret; if no distinguishable validation pairs use frozen final epoch; regression never breaks ties
training.objective: stage root-relative log-cost interval regression and matched-prefix pair ranking; policy baseline retains whole-trajectory preference loss

limitations: All action targets re-enumerated per actual IR. One all-advance continuation, finite conditional value not Q*. Validation regret restricted to sampled candidate set. Seen Queens/Puzzle never select epochs. Default seat is charged as one of three terminals; search protection is not memory. Do not lower thresholds or replace programs based on measured effects.
